extraction_notes: PDF identity verified from the MMBTA55 title, PNP TRANSISTORS heading, Rev:1.1 footer, and Zhuhai Hongjiacheng Technology Co., Ltd. footer; catalog manufacturer string preserved exactly as hongjiacheng.
Only observed DC F2 evidence is retained. The fT row and any AC capacitance evidence are omitted by scope; ft, cobo, and cibo remain null.

Curve points are compact manual read-offs from plotted traces. No interpolation was used. Plotted mA, uA, and mV values were converted to SI units A and V, and PNP current and voltage polarity is preserved as negative.

The electrical-characteristics table gives hFE and V(BR)CEO as guaranteed minimum or maximum bounds and VCE(sat) as a guaranteed maximum; bound source_kind values are retained and are not treated as typical values.

The table's Base-Emitter Saturation Voltage row gives IC = -10 mA and VCE = -1.0 V but no IB, so it is not forced into a paired saturation point. Paired saturation points are taken from the beta = 10 plotted curves; base current is the stated beta relation at the plotted collector-current read-offs.
The schema has no dedicated scalar VBE(on) field; the available VBE(on) information is represented by the digitized Fig. 5 curves.
